title: Genetic Algorithms
lead: Covers: optimisation problems (decision variables, objective function, constraints), why derivatives and hill climbing fail, meta-heuristic (population-based) search, genetic algorithm terminology, encoding, the GA loop, roulette-wheel and tournament selection, crossover, mutation, replacement and termination, worked iterations (x squared and knapsack), special cases (travelling salesman with random keys, real-coded and multi-objective problems) and global, local and near optima. No prior lecture attendance needed.
